SUPERIOR COURT OF NEW JERSEY
MIDDLESEX COUNTY SUPERIOR COURT
SHERIFF'S SALE NO. 26001162
DOCKET NO. F01352325
PLAINTIFF – WILMINGTON SAVINGS FUND SOCIETY, FSB, NOT IN ITS INDIVIDUAL CAPACITY BUT SOLELY AS TRUSTEE OF ARUGULA FUNDING TITLING TRUST
DEFENDANTS- GLORIA BREEDON, ET ALS.
Writ of Execution.
By virtue of the above stated Writ of Execution to me directed and delivered I will expose for sale at public vendue on
Wednesday THE 2nd DAY OF September 2026
between the hours of twelve and five o'clock in the afternoon of said day, that is to say at 1:30 P.M. prevailing time at The Heldrich Hotel, 10 Livingston Avenue, New Brunswick, New Jersey 08901 to wit:
All that tract or parcel of land, situate, lying and being in the Township of NORTH BRUNSWICK, County of Middlesex and State of New Jersey:
Being known as: LOT 9.213 FKA 9 BLOCK 140.01 FKA 140.1 FKA 242 QUALIFIER C0213
PREMISES COMMONLY KNOWN AS:
809 NORTH OAKS BOULEVARD NORTH BRUNSWICK, NJ 08902
A more complete metes and bounds description can be found in the Office of the Middlesex County Clerk.
Lien(s)/Taxes: The property to be sold is located in the Township of North Brunswick in the County of MIDDLESEX and State of New Jersey.
Commonly known as 809 N OAKS BOULEVARD, NORTH BRUNSWICK, NJ 08902
Tax LOT 9.213 FKA 9 BLOCK 140.01 FKA 140.1 FKA 242 QUALIFIER C0213
Dimensions of Lot: Together with an undivided 0.5102% percentage interest in and to the common elements of The Oaks at North Brunswick Condominium
Nearest Cross Street: Livingston Ave.
Estimated upset bid amount: $29,000.00 plus any additional sums as ordered by the court
Occupancy Status: Owner Occupied
THE SHERIFF HEREBY RESERVES THE RIGHT TO ADJOURN THIS SALE WITHOUT FURTHER NOTICE THROUGH PUBLICATION.
2026 Qtr. 2 Due: 05/01/2026 $734.76 OPEN
Prospective purchasers are on notice that there is a senior mortgage originally made in favor of ('Mers') Mortgage Electronic Registration Systems, Inc. acting solely as nominee for CitiMortgage, Inc. by Gloria Breedon Dated 12/12/07 and Recorded 5/29/07 BK 12384 PG 76 Instrument no.: MG 2007 021245 w/the Middlesex County Clerk/Register in the original amount of $148,200.00. It was assigned to CitiMortgage, Inc. by assignment dated 3/1/17 and recorded 3/16/17 In BK 1206 PG 232 w/the Middlesex County Clerk/Register. It was further assigned to Towd Point Master Funding Trust by assignment dated 11/12/18 and recorded 11/14/18 in BK 17349 PG 1577 w/the Middlesex County Clerk/ Register. It was further assigned to FirstKey Mortgage LLC by assignment dated 9/20/19 and recorded 10/9/19 in BK 17647 PG 575. The mortgage that is being foreclosed was subordinated to the mortgage recorded 5/29/07 by subordination agreement dated 4/5/07 and recorded 5/29/07 in MB 426 PG 401 w/the Middlesex County Clerk/Register.
Note: The street address is merely given as a convenience to the bidders and is not a representation of fact on the part of the sheriff. The diagram or concise description does not constitute a full legal description of the premises, but it can be found in the Middlesex County Clerk’s Office.
Subject to any unpaid taxes, municipal liens or other charges, and any such taxes, charges, liens, insurance premiums or other advances made by plaintiff prior to this sale. All interested parties are to conduct and rely upon their own independent investigation to ascertain whether or not any outstanding interest remain of record and/or have priority over the lien being foreclosed and, if so, the current amount due thereon.
If the sale is set aside for any reason, the Purchaser at the sale shall be entitled only to a return of the deposit paid. The Purchaser shall have no further recourse against the Mortgagor, the Mortgagee and the Mortgagee’s attorney.
Surplus Money: If after the sale and satisfaction of the mortgage debt, including costs and expenses, there remains any surplus money, the money will be deposited into the Superior Court Trust Fund and any person claiming the surplus, or any part thereof, may file a motion pursuant to Court Rules 4:64-3 and 4:57-2 stating the nature and extent of that person's claim and asking for an order directing payment of the surplus money. The Sheriff or other person conducting the sale will have information regarding the surplus, if any.
The approximate amount due on this execution is $24,894.80 plus interest, cost, printers’ fees, Sheriff's fees and commission. The prior liens, as per affidavit of consideration are not a representation of fact on the part of the Sheriff.
MILDRED S. SCOTT
SHERIFF
DATED: June 2, 2026
ROBERTSON, ANSCHUTZ, SCHNEID, CRANE & PARTNERS, PLLC

FAIRFIELD, NJ 07004
